traits.name: Gifted Craftsmen
traits.text:
A kuah-lij has proficiency in alchemist’s supplies,
jeweler’s tools, and smith’s tools.

traits.name: Magical Sight
traits.text:
A kuah-lij can sense the presence of magic within 30
feet of it. It can use an action to see a faint aura around any visible creature
or object in the area that bears magic, and it learns its school of magic,
if any.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text:
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range
20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft.,
one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
